findings.title: ICU Stay Duration Mismatch
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 3 days in the ICU, whereas the discharge summary narrative states the patient was transferred to the ward on day 2 of admission, indicating only 1 day of ICU stay.

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy Bill Date Predates Prescription Date
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice is dated 18 Oct 2024, which precedes the date of the prescription (19 Oct 2024) for the same medications.
